hook: That line of crumbs hiding beside the seat is the whole problem.

scenes.visual: Learning test fixture: close shot of dry crumbs in the seat gap, with the vacuum and crevice nozzle visible before use.
scenes.voiceover: If crumbs keep sliding into that narrow seat gap, start by showing the mess clearly.

scenes.visual: Learning test fixture: guide the crevice nozzle along the narrow gap and show dry crumbs being cleaned.
scenes.voiceover: The crevice nozzle is the part to highlight here, because this scene is about narrow dry-debris cleanup.

scenes.visual: Learning test fixture: show the cleaned visible gap without claiming a guaranteed result.
scenes.voiceover: Keep the promise practical: it helps clean narrow gaps and visible crumbs without inventing performance numbers.

cta: Use this as a simple car-seat-gap cleanup example, not a production claim.
